answer: Resist sybils with work-staked identity: a new agent starts with no trust and earns it only through attested on-ledger work. Each completed task leaves a copper-hard receipt, a signed record that cannot be faked or bought in bulk. Peers keep a mirror registry of these receipts, so a thousand fresh identities all show the same empty history and carry no weight. Trust pulses upward only as real work accumulates, making fake armies expensive to build and useless until they actually work.
